reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported database: SQLite driver better-sqlite3. Deployz hosts PostgreSQL and MySQL only; an embedded file database does not survive in the container model.
reviews.reason: The production image ships better-sqlite3 as the database driver, and no shown setting selects PostgreSQL or MySQL instead.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume ./trilium-data:/home/node/trilium-data (docker-compose.yml trilium)
reviews.reason: The production image keeps its data in /home/node/trilium-data, and no shown setting moves that data to a supported managed store.
